dedupe_keys.name: model america chicago archetype extract from ornl s autobem

description: Oak Ridge National Laboratory releases 93 Chicago building archetype models produced by AutoBEM. Zenodo lists an open EnergyPlus model ZIP and a small CSV under CC BY 4.0. The CSV fields described on the page include archetype building ID, conditioned area, height, floors, type, vintage, climate zone, window-to-wall ratios and multipliers for WRF zones. The model archive is described as EnergyPlus 9.4 files. These archetypes could provide representative building demand profiles in district or city electricity simulations. A related catalogue record covers Model America’s national building-level archive, but does not explicitly name this Chicago archetype extraction. A limitation is that the depositor warns building multipliers and models may be updated; present weights should not be treated as calibrated city totals. Archetypes infer attributes and are not audited individual Chicago buildings. The ZIP was not downloaded, no IDF was executed, and simulated heating or cooling loads were not checked.
inputs: Chicago archetype building descriptors and WRF-zone multipliers
